title: Rosemary
summary: RO'SEMARY, noun [Latin rosmarinus, sea-rose; rosa and marinus.] A verticillate plant of the genus Rosmarinus, growing naturally in the southern part of France, Spain and Italy. It has a fragrant smell

inlines.v: RO'SEMARY, noun [Latin rosmarinus, sea-rose; rosa and marinus.] A verticillate plant of the genus Rosmarinus, growing naturally in the southern part of France, Spain and Italy. It has a fragrant smell and a warm pungent bitterish taste.
